change: Placing one center point again snaps that point only; the other three points keep their positions (1.3.1 snapped all four again). LUMEN carries an on-screen label 「検証中」 (Under verification); the calculations are unchanged by the label.
evaluation: The technical evaluation and the reproducibility materials were produced with version 1.3.1 (below). With the 1.3.2 engine and worker, the reproducibility runner gave the same 32 region-condition rows (Node.js; not a browser evaluation).

evaluated_version_1.3.1.html_difference: Only two default UI language expressions changed from Japanese to English. Reversing those expressions gives the evaluated browser HTML hash exactly.
